source_triangle_rule: Single primitive 0: source_triangle = faceIndex. Actual serialized indices verified with vertex-to-source map. Not the old four-primitive GLB binding.
uv_convention: glTF UV = (Blender U, 1 - Blender V). PNG row zero is top. No further flip for GLTFLoader textures.
required_runtime_extension_for_coat: KHR_materials_clearcoat (core PBR base color still works without coat)
limitations: Baked orange GLB is a static interchange test, not an interactive selection implementation.
Texture 2 is an unused-by-core mask referenced by extras; a future shader/CPU UV lookup must explicitly load it.
Local UV chart only; rest of body points at an unpainted texel. Not a full-body UV atlas.
